q: What is the carbon footprint of pharmaceutical glass vials and ampoules?
title: Glass vials and ampoules
short: Most of it sits in the glass tubing, melted in a furnace from sand and other minerals. Converters then form vials and ampoules with gas and oxygen flames, then anneal them. Ask the tubing supplier for its figure per kg, and add your forming fuel, oxygen and annealing per thousand pieces.
audience: Pharma packaging converters and drug makers

ul: Forming burners: natural gas or LPG (Scope 1).

p: Divide each by good pieces made; rejects count against the batch.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol standards, including the Product Standard
